# Clip Culture Barbershop

> Clip Culture Barbershop is a barbershop in Sandy Springs, Georgia, founded by owner and master barber David Brown in 2017. It offers haircuts, fades, lineups, beard trims, hot towel shaves, and kids', teens', women's, and senior cuts. Walk-ins are welcome and online booking is available.

- Address: 6309 Roswell Road NE #2D, Sandy Springs, GA 30328
- Phone: (404) 458-2993
- Email: info@clipculturebarbershop.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9 AM–7 PM; Sunday 12 PM–4 PM
- Prices: Basic Haircut $20; Basic Lineup $20; fades $35; Child Haircut (10 and under) $25; Teen Haircut (11-16) $30; Senior Citizen Haircut (62+) $30
- Policies: cancel at least 4 hours before your appointment; arriving 5 or more minutes late may cancel the appointment with a $15 no-show fee
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/clipculturebarbershop/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/clipculturebarbershop
